newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 607 c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 607 c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market's eastern indicator remained steady on 607 cents a kg clean at auctions in Sydney on Thursday, Wool International (WI) said.
In merino fleece, the 19 micron indicator was slightly dearer, 20/25/26m were 0.5 percent dearer and 24m up to 1.0 percent dearer, WI said.
But 21/22m were 0.5 percent cheaper and 23m was unchanged.
In crossbreds, 27/29/30/31m were unchanged and 28m slightly dearer.
In cardings, washing locks were unchanged, light carbonising locks slightly dearer and crutchings 1.0 percent dearer.
Japanese interests provided principal competition with good support from most sectors of the trade, WI said.
Of the 11,129 bales offered in Sydney, 13.2 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 101,000 bales on offer.
